VBO:0200684.shortDescription: The Huskamute is an Alaskan Malamute–Siberian Husky cross.

sources.title: Sled Dog Society of Wales — Huskamute cross definition
sources.evidence: Fresh substantive club page read: explicitly defines Huskamute as Alaskan Malamute/Siberian Husky cross. Parentage only adopted. Parent-derived gentleness, trainability, sled performance, rigid blue-eye appearance, weight and family-suitability claims are not reliable uniform attributes and are excluded.
